comment: 14yo male, recently confirmed germline NF2 c.169C>T (p.Arg57Ter) pathogenic variant identified via cascade testing after maternal uncle diagnosed with bilateral vestibular schwannomas at age 23 (treated with right-sided hearing-preservation microsurgery + left-sided bevacizumab — currently maintenance dosing with preserved AAO-HNS Class B hearing on the left). Baseline ophthalmology at proband-discovery age 14 detected bilateral juvenile posterior subcapsular lenticular cataracts (~60% NF2 prevalence — earliest detectable feature). Initial brain MRI with thin-cut IAC sequences shows no vestibular schwannoma; whole-spine MRI is normal. Annual audiology pure-tone audiometry + speech-discrimination is normal bilaterally. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = NF2-related schwannomatosis carrier surveillance — brain MRI with thin-cut IAC sequences q1-2y from age 10 (currently within window; ongoing surveillance) + whole-spine MRI q3-5y + audiology + speech-discrimination annually + ophthalmology q1-2y (already detected cataracts — annual follow-up) + dermatology q1-2y + cascade testing for younger siblings + multidisciplinary NF2-expert-center referral; alternative = intensified track with annual brain MRI q1y + high-resolution IAC sequences + earlier bevacizumab initiation if vestibular schwannoma emerges with hearing decline + prophylactic hearing-preservation surgical consideration for unilateral lesion before contralateral involvement + sign-language and cochlear-implant pre-emptive planning. NF2 disease anchor approximation routes via DIS-GLIOMA-LOW-GRADE — flagged for v0.4 cleanup when DIS-VESTIBULAR-SCHWANNOMA / DIS-MENINGIOMA / DIS-EPENDYMOMA entities land. CRITICAL severity.
